purpose: Persistent orchestration contract for chat-independent Trading Agent research and engineering.
capacity_pulse_policy: 10-minute schedule with independent lane-scoped Windows concurrency; local_reproduction shares the explicit long-reproduction priority group while data_qa remains independently schedulable

orchestration_policy.scientific_decision_authority: orchestrator + formal governance, never delegated AI
orchestration_policy.evidence_rule: AI/agent outputs are never scientific evidence or authorization by themselves
orchestration_policy.performance_rule: no performance, holdout, candidate selection or promotion without explicit formal governance
orchestration_policy.acceleration_rule: verify current state -> snapshot live capacity -> parallelize independent work -> use the smallest useful free resource -> cheap falsify early -> expose robustness early -> immediately independently replicate a complete formal pass

permanent_self_hosted_research.description: Two Windows slots operate as Lane A (Formal Readiness) and Lane B (Frontier Discovery). Deterministic hosted frontier work also uses bounded concurrency.

concurrency.policy: no workflow-level serialization; one bounded stream per physical lane; long independent Q121-R6 reproduction can cancel/preempt local_reproduction only

hosted_research_failover.purpose: fallback only when self-hosted heartbeat is stale

free_ai_worker_fabric.routing: scheduled OpenRouter free; Gemini legacy API and Mistral retained manual-only when explicitly dispatched

local_ai_worker_rotation.dependency: real local AI readiness must pass
local_ai_worker_rotation.note: Isolated from the permanent 10-minute research loop so local AI cannot occupy a research slot and serialize subsequent pulses.

hosted_deterministic_frontier.workpack_rotation: three equal 10-step packs covering all 30 frontier worker steps

current_research_focus.completed: Q119 Treasury demand-shape design merged; I22 SEC filing-arrival session-window correction merged
current_research_focus.active_next: SEC/13F/XBRL + Treasury/CFTC + Q121 + Q126-Q132 source/PIT feasibility; Q119 Treasury demand-shape; Q120 CFTC TFF release-date semantics; I22 filing-arrival; Q104 I19/I20 historical breadth; Q125 SEC publication clock.
current_research_focus.meta_research: ECL runtime hardening and first valid model-metrics receipt
current_research_focus.discovery_frontier: Q121 SEC beneficial-ownership disclosure timing plus Q126-Q132 discovery/PIT feasibility; Q128/Q129/Q130 remain source-blocked until free reproducible historical data is established; no performance authorization

resource_routing.last_verified_snapshot_note: runner online/busy state is volatile and must be checked live on every new chat
resource_routing.copilot_free_protection: max 4 protected sessions/month, max 30 credits/session, no overages
resource_routing.codespaces: interactive fallback only; no unattended default

s10.routing_rule: use only when available + independent + permitted + useful
s10.scientific_role: bounded support only; never scientific evidence, authorization, selection, promotion or live execution
s10.quota_policy: no artificial consumption; fail-closed when unavailable
s10.persistence_note: S10 is the dedicated phone/Termux resource; exact runtime stack and interface must be discovered from the phone, not inferred from the Windows runners
s10.routing_contract: Research OS may route S10 only when the synchronized receipt reports S10_UTILITY_ACCEPTED
s10.full_acceptance_policy: 36-case R3 benchmark only on onboarding or explicit revalidation; never as recurring default workload
s10.event_driven_review: meaningful research-runner or critical-governance change plus regular two-hour mechanical-QA cadence; semantic review remains explicit

android_phone_fleet.activation_rule: Only online uniquely-labelled runners are scheduled. Unaccepted online devices run onboarding acceptance; accepted devices run bounded utility review. Utility runs never create scientific evidence or authorization.
android_phone_fleet.scientific_role: bounded support only; never scientific evidence, authorization, selection, ranking, promotion or live execution
android_phone_fleet.capacity_policy: Activate at most one additional Samsung device as a controlled capacity test when measurable throughput gain is expected; do not activate dormant slots merely to consume quota.
android_phone_fleet.capacity_decision: Do not add a physical device merely for nominal capacity; activate at most one additional device as a controlled test when measured independent throughput gain is expected.

chatless_night_policy.primary_path: permanent self-hosted research pulses every 10 minutes with independent lane concurrency
chatless_night_policy.failover_path: hosted failover every 30 minutes when heartbeat stale
chatless_night_policy.ai_rotation: free AI fabric every 6 hours when provider entitlement/auth passes
chatless_night_policy.persistence: receipts/artifacts/status are written to repository or Actions artifacts; no open chat required

s10.trigger: every two hours plus meaningful research-runner or critical-governance push changes; semantic utility/evidence-critic only when explicitly selected

android_phone_fleet.trigger: every 6h only for online slots; acceptance for new slots, utility for accepted slots

new_chat_protocol: Read docs/TRADING_AGENT_OS_ORCHESTRATION.md and the live current status files.
Read research/governance/persistent_research_acceleration_contract.json and apply its accelerated parallelism/resource-routing logic.
Read ops/s10_runtime_status.json and route S10 only when its current receipt reports S10_UTILITY_ACCEPTED.
Treat S10 as the dedicated Android/Termux phone; check its live availability/capability from the phone-side runtime before assigning bounded work.
Check current master, PRs, workflows, runners and AI entitlements live.
Do not trust stale runner/auth/queue claims from prior chats.
Continue unfinished safe work without redundant approval.
Use chat mainly for strategic decisions, scientific interpretation, ambiguity and important developments.

two_lane_research_mode.performance_capacity_rule: Physical two-slot capacity never creates authorization; each performance execution needs its own current formal authorization.

dashboard.update_button: opens the GitHub Actions workflow page; authenticated user can run the dashboard update
